event:
I withdrew the finding, and the verdict was accepted.

The plan item `chip_sw_aon_timer_sleep_wakeup` lists two tests, not one. Its `tests:` field names `chip_sw_pwrmgr_smoketest`, and its `bazel:` field names both `//sw/device/tests:pwrmgr_smoketest` and `//sw/device/tests:aon_timer_smoketest`. So `aon_timer_smoketest` is not expected to cover every step on its own.

I only grepped `pwrmgr_smoketest.c` and did not read it in full. It matches the plan item's rstmgr steps: it checks the POR reset cause (line 62), configures the AON wakeup, and checks reset info after the wakeup (line 81). I did not confirm the deep-sleep entry or the post-sequence wakeup-threshold read in it.

The finding is right that `aon_timer_smoketest` itself never sleeps or resets. It only checks that the wakeup IRQ is pending. That is a limit of this one test within a split plan item, not a mismatch.

I added `pwrmgr_smoketest.c` to the verdict as a new source.
